aiInstructions:
To find catalog entries matching a user's topic, embed the CORE
CONCEPT of their question (short noun phrase) using the
ai_embeddings plugin with the aivia connection string, then rank
by series_cosine_similarity descending. Report how many rows
score above 0.45 before listing the top matches. Similarity is
relative closeness, never a probability. If nothing scores above
0.45, say the catalog has nothing sufficiently related.
